rust-signal-dev.description: Develop and debug the Rust signal/media service (apps/signal). Specializes in mediasoup, WebRTC signaling, producer/consumer lifecycle, and socket.io message routing.

rust-signal-lead.description: Lead the Rust Signal team (apps/signal). Coordinates WebRTC signaling, mediasoup lifecycle, GStreamer recording, and socket.io message routing.

rust-qa-engineer.description: QA for Rust Signal team. Enforces memory safety, concurrency correctness, lock discipline, and zero-cost abstraction patterns.

rust-test-engineer.description: Test for Rust Signal team. Designs testing strategy for mediasoup signaling, room management, and WebRTC lifecycle.

rust-docs-writer.description: Docs for Rust Signal team. Maintains protocol specs, architecture docs, and API references for the media/real-time service.

web-frontend-dev.description: Develop the Next.js web client (apps/web). Specializes in mediasoup-client, WebRTC video rendering, Shadcn UI, and socket.io signaling client.

web-frontend-lead.description: Lead the Web Frontend team (apps/web). Coordinates architecture, roadmap, and delivery of auth UI, booking, tutor discovery, and media session features.

web-qa-engineer.description: QA for Web Frontend team. Enforces TypeScript strictness, React patterns, accessibility, and code quality for the Next.js client.

web-test-engineer.description: Test for Web Frontend team. Designs test strategy for the Next.js client including unit, integration, and E2E tests.

web-docs-writer.description: Docs for Web Frontend team. Creates and maintains frontend documentation, component catalogs, and user flow guides.

crypto-e2ee.description: Implement E2EE cryptography: OPAQUE protocol, WebAuthn passkeys, key hierarchy (MK/KEK/DHKE), recovery codes, and WASM crypto modules.

crypto-lead.description: Lead the E2EE/Cryptography team. Owns key hierarchy, OPAQUE protocol, WebAuthn passkey flows, WASM crypto, and recovery code system.

crypto-qa-engineer.description: QA for E2EE/Cryptography team. Enforces cryptographic correctness, timing safety, key management best practices, and protocol security invariants.

crypto-test-engineer.description: Test for E2EE/Cryptography team. Designs test strategy for OPAQUE protocol, key derivation, WebAuthn flows, and recovery code system.

crypto-docs-writer.description: Docs for E2EE/Cryptography team. Maintains E2EE architecture docs, key hierarchy spec, protocol flow docs, and threat model.

go-backend-dev.description: Develop Go Fiber core backend: business logic, PostgreSQL with RLS, Stripe payments, Asynq jobs, and gRPC service definitions.

go-backend-lead.description: Lead the Go Backend team (apps/dbal). Owns core business logic, data authority, API contracts, Stripe integration, and gRPC service design.

go-qa-engineer.description: QA for Go Backend team. Enforces error handling, circuit breaker patterns, idempotency, context propagation, and database access patterns.

go-test-engineer.description: Test for Go Backend team. Designs test strategy for the core backend including unit, integration, and E2E tests for booking/payment flows.

go-docs-writer.description: Docs for Go Backend team. Maintains API reference, gRPC proto specs, database schema docs, and integration guides.

infra-ops.description: Manage infrastructure: Docker Compose, Vault PKI, TLS/mTLS, NATS JetStream, and observability (OTel, Prometheus, Grafana).

infra-lead.description: Lead the Infrastructure & Platform team. Owns Docker Compose, Vault PKI, TLS/mTLS, NATS, observability, and CI/CD.

infra-qa-engineer.description: QA for Infrastructure team. Enforces security hardening, configuration best practices, TLS correctness, and disaster recovery readiness.

infra-test-engineer.description: Test for Infrastructure team. Designs integration tests for infrastructure, disaster recovery, and chaos engineering scenarios.

infra-docs-writer.description: Docs for Infrastructure team. Maintains deployment guides, configuration reference, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.

python-ai-dev.description: Build Python AI service (apps/assistance_ranking). Expert in FastAPI, LangGraph multi-agent workflows, Ollama LLM, Qdrant, Neo4j, NATS JetStream, and async Python.

python-ai-lead.description: Lead the Python AI team (apps/assistance_ranking). Coordinates LangGraph workflows, LLM integration, vector/graph search, and NATS event processing.

python-qa-engineer.description: QA for Python AI team. Enforces async correctness, LLM output validation, agent safety guardrails, and gRPC/JWT security.

python-test-engineer.description: Test for Python AI team. Designs test strategy for LangGraph agent workflows, gRPC services, and LLM integration.

python-docs-writer.description: Docs for Python AI team. Maintains agent workflow docs, prompt catalog, gRPC API reference, and integration guides.

code-review-qa.description: Review code for bugs, correctness, test coverage, and quality across all services. Ensures Rust safety, TypeScript strictness, and Go error handling.

head-of-engineering.description: Strategic technical oversight: roadmap prioritization, architecture trade-offs, cross-service coordination, and risk assessment.

system-architect.description: Analyze system architecture: service boundaries, data flow, communication patterns, coupling, and scaling bottlenecks.

security-auditor.description: Audit security: zero-trust architecture, E2EE correctness, authentication flows, key management, TLS/mTLS enforcement, attack surface.

ui-ux-designer.description: Design UI/UX: Shadcn/Radix patterns, responsive layouts, Tailwind CSS v4, accessibility (a11y), form design, media session UI, mobile-first responsive design.

frontend-dev.description: Build frontend code across all clients. Specializes in Next.js App Router, React 19 RSC, Tanstack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Shadcn, and NestJS API gateway.

product-manager.description: Product manager: defines product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing feature prioritization. Translates business needs into technical specifications.

flutter-mobile-dev.description: Senior Flutter/Dart engineer for the planned mobile client. Expert in cross-platform UI, WebRTC via flutter-webrtc/mediasoup-client, secure local storage, and reactive state management.

dotnet-core-dev.description: Senior .NET/C# engineer for the planned dotnet service. Expert in ASP.NET Core minimal APIs, EF Core, webhook processing, email delivery (SendGrid/SMTP), and background jobs.

stripe-expert.description: Expert advisor for Stripe integration — Payments, Connect, Subscriptions, Checkout, Elements, Webhooks, idempotency, marketplace payouts, fraud prevention, and compliance.
